answer: Every claim must carry a lesson behind it. Within the last month, the filer taught a newcomer in the Harbor hall, guiding their first comet job from first draft to finished work, and the Harbor clerk checks the lesson within a day, reading the delta between the newcomer's first draft and the finished job. A claim with no lesson, or one the newcomer denies, is rejected and forfeits a 250-coin bond, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 taught newcomers plus 250,000 coins in bonds. One operator invented forty newcomers, none could show a single lesson, and every claim died in the Harbor.
